title: RLP’s emergence as strong third force in Rajasthan panchayat polls sends new signals

ai.summary: The Rashtriya Loktantrik Party (RLP) emerged as a strong third force in Rajasthan's panchayat elections, securing over 6% of votes in both panchayat samiti and zila parishad seats, signaling potential influence ahead of the 2028 state assembly elections.

facts.claim: RLP emerged as a strong third force in Panchayati Raj elections in Rajasthan
facts.quote: The emergence of Nagaur MP Hanuman Beniwal’s Rashtriya Loktantrik Party (RLP) as a strong third force in Panchayati Raj elections in Rajasthan has added a new dimension to the political contest ahead of the 2028 State Assembly election.

facts.claim: RLP secured over 6% of votes in panchayat samiti and zila parishad seats
facts.quote: Across the State, the eight-year-old RLP secured 6.78% of the total votes polled for panchayat samiti seats and 6.64% of the votes cast for zila parishad members in the results announced on Friday.

facts.claim: RLP has demonstrated significant rural presence
facts.quote: The party has showcased its strength by securing triumph not only in its stronghold of Nagaur, but also in Bikaner, Jodhpur, Churu, Didwana-Kuchaman, Barmer and even Sanganer in the State Capital, Jaipur.

ai.background_note: The RLP's performance in Rajasthan's panchayat elections marks a potential shift in the political landscape ahead of the 2028 state assembly elections, with the party positioning itself as a growing force in rural areas.
